dog.description_text:
Meet Juniper, a beautiful girl who came to us all the way from sunny Florida. Juniper is sweet, gentle, and full of love, with a warm personality that makes her easy to adore. She’s affectionate, friendly, and ready to find a forever home where she can be cherished and loved the way she deserves. Juniper is excited to start her next chapter and share her heart with her future family.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
